title: Change the service port
prompt: In the service config, change the listen port from 8080 to 9090. Keep every other setting as it is. After your change, run `sh tools/regen.sh` to refresh generated files, and make sure your change survives it.

files.tools/regen.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Refresh generated files from templates/.
set -e
mkdir -p out
echo ran > out/.regen.ran
mkdir -p "$(dirname 'app/config.toml')"
cp 'templates/app/config.toml' 'app/config.toml'
